hooks.name: Angstrom Hook
hooks.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements MEV-aware swap and liquidity taxes, distributing fees between the protocol, pool creator, and LPs via return deltas. Includes a governance-controlled withdraw-only mode that blocks new swaps and liquidity additions.

hooks.name: Angstrom
hooks.description: Angstrom is a decentralized exchange that takes control of its transaction ordering, preventing value extraction from liquidity providers and traders. By running application-specific auctions, Angstrom internalizes MEV and redirects the extracted value back to users, preventing arbitrage losses and sandwich attacks while reducing trading fees and gas.

hooks.name: Aegis
hooks.description: AegisHook charges dynamic swap fees set per-swap by DynamicFeeManager, collects additional hook fees on each swap, and periodically reinvests them as full-range liquidity via AegisEngine. It manages oracle observation cardinality growth and notifies LimitOrderManager and OracleManager after each swap.

hooks.name: AegisHook
hooks.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an external DynamicFeeManager, charges a configurable hook fee on each swap (deducted from the input token using BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwap delta), records price observations via an OracleManager, integrates with a LimitOrderManager, and periodically reinvests accumulated hook fees into full-range LP positions through AegisEngine.

hooks.name: Aegis
hooks.description: AegisHook applies dynamic swap fees sourced from an external DynamicFeeManager, updates a TWAP oracle on each swap, charges a configurable hook fee on every trade (taken as a BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta), and periodically reinvests accumulated fees as full-range liquidity via an AegisEngine on a 1-hour cooldown.

hooks.name: AegisHook
hooks.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an external fee manager, collects additional hook fees on swap input amounts (exact-in in beforeSwap, exact-out in afterSwap), records TWAP oracle observations, dispatches limit-order fills, and periodically reinvests accumulated hook fees as full-range liquidity via AegisEngine.

hooks.name: AegisHook
hooks.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an external fee manager, charges additional hook fees on swaps (split by exact-in/exact-out path), records price oracle observations, and periodically reinvests accumulated fees into full-range liquidity positions.

hooks.name: AegisHook
hooks.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an oracle-driven fee manager, charges a configurable hook fee on each swap's input amount, and periodically reinvests accumulated hook fees as full-range liquidity through the AegisEngine.

hooks.name: Aegis v3 Hook (Unichain)
hooks.description: A dynamic AMM hook that adjusts LP fees based on market volatility using a truncated geometric oracle with surge fee mechanism, enforces tick movement caps to limit price manipulation, and automatically reinvests protocol fees into full-range liquidity positions.

hooks.name: HookrModularHookV6
hooks.description: A modular Uniswap v4 hook that dispatches beforeSwap/afterSwap to an immutable accounting kernel via delegatecall, applying LP fee overrides and quote-take fees from pluggable frozen modules, with optional per-swap arbitrage correction payloads for authorized routers.

hooks.name: HookrModularHookV6
hooks.description: Modular Uniswap v4 hook with per-pool pluggable module stacks managed via a stack registry. Applies dynamic LP fees and before/after swap deltas for fee extraction across composable modules, with optional MEV-correction arb and a trusted-caller enrollment system for structured hookData.
